clip.title: Clip
clip.adaptersHint: LoRAs you added in Manage models. Off until you turn one on. Strength 0.7.
clip.encodersHint: Text encoders you added in Manage models. The shipped one runs unless you pick another.

messages.queued: Batch queued. Batches render one at a time; you can add more while this one runs.
messages.loadedSettings: Loaded "{{name}}" settings into the panel — adjust anything, then Generate.
messages.loadedCoreSettings: Loaded "{{name}}" core settings (older batch — double-check resolution/duration).
messages.seedSet: Seed {{seed}} is set in Advanced. Clear it to get random seeds again.

confirm.deleteVideoText: Removes the file. Other clips in the batch stay.
confirm.deleteVideoKeeps: the rest of this batch, other batches, the form
confirm.cancelBatchText: Stops the GPU job. Clips already written stay on disk.
confirm.cancelBatchKeeps: finished videos in this batch, the form, other batches
confirm.deleteBatchText: Removes this batch and every video in it.
confirm.deleteBatchKeeps: other batches, installed models, and the prompt in the form

notReady.alert: <bold>{{name}} isn’t fully installed.</bold> Generating now would silently fall back to a lower-quality model — so it’s blocked. Install it first{{missing}}, then generate again.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How this job spends the GPU.
mode.lowVramTooltip: Reduces frames, resolution, and steps for CogVideoX and Wan, for a card that runs out of memory. Off by default.
mode.lowVramOtherModel: Clamps frames, resolution and steps for CogVideoX and Wan only; this model renders at the settings shown.
mode.highConsistencyTooltip: Director, keyframe→I2V, cinema post, face restore when available. Turns Low VRAM off.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.modeReferencesTooltip: Pictures, clips and audio the clip keeps: who is in it, how it moves, how it sounds.
prompt.galleryHint: Written in the model's structured prompt format. More in the <galleryLink>community gallery</galleryLink>.
prompt.referencesPlaceholder: Maya walks into the cafe, looks at the camera and says "Morning!"
prompt.referencesHelp: Use the names you gave above, or click a tag to insert it. Write a spoken line as: the chef says: "…"
prompt.referencesHelpVerbatim: Enhance is off: this is sent as typed, so name references by their tags.
prompt.whatToSee: What do you want to see? (one prompt per line)
prompt.storyboardPlaceholder: A lone astronaut discovers a bioluminescent forest on an alien moon
prompt.textPlaceholder: A majestic eagle soaring over mountains at sunset
prompt.storyboardHelp: One concept only — becomes {{count}} connected shots.
prompt.clipsHelp: {{count}} clips — Look & Feel applies to all.
prompt.describeEndFrame: Describe the video that ends on the end frame
prompt.motionPlaceholder: Slow camera zoom in with a gentle head turn
prompt.dropImages: Drop images here, or click to upload
prompt.endFrameHintL2v: The clip ends on this picture. Without a start image, it is made from your description.
prompt.endFrameHint: The clip ends on this picture.
prompt.lookAndFeelPlaceholder: moody cinematic, golden hour, shallow depth of field
prompt.lookAndFeelHelp: Optional style applied to every prompt.
prompt.negativeUnused: This model samples without CFG — negative prompt is not used.
prompt.exactTextTooltip: Light enhancement only — keeps on-screen text and logos.
prompt.enhanceVerbatim: Verbatim prompts is on in Settings: the prompt is sent as typed and this does nothing.
prompt.enhanceTooltip: Adds quality and motion descriptors. Motion chips and Prompt style do nothing when this is off.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Shot writing and identity. High consistency turns these on.
pipeline.directorTooltip: Rewrites each prompt into a cinematic shot before generation.
pipeline.keyframeCast: On because a cast member is selected.
pipeline.keyframeTooltip: Still first, then image-to-video. Sharper than pure text-to-video.
pipeline.storyboardTooltip: One concept becomes N connected shots.
pipeline.keyframeFromCast: Keyframe model is the character's training base. Training images are never start frames.
pipeline.castLoadFailed: Cast Library could not be loaded: {{reason}}. <retry>Retry</retry>
pipeline.noCast: Train a character in Cast Library to lock identity into every keyframe.
pipeline.castHelp: LoRA + prompt invent each keyframe still, then animate.

finish.title: Finish
finish.pngFramesTooltip: Also save a lossless PNG sequence beside the MP4.
finish.seedFixed: Every clip in this batch uses seed {{seed}}. Clear it for a new random seed per clip.
finish.seedTooBig: Seeds go up to {{max}}; this one is ignored.

progress.title: Current Progress
progress.noRetryData: Original prompts & settings weren't saved for this batch (created before retry support), so it can't be auto-retried. Recreate it from the settings above.
progress.none: No active generation. Start a video generation above to see progress here.
